melee.name: Hedgeguard
melee.description: A stout-hearted close-up defender who protects friends with a sturdy shield, a well-made tool, and a brave stance.

ranged.name: Thornshot
ranged.description: A nimble scout who keeps trouble at a distance with a sling, a bow, or a carefully tossed pinecone.

ranged.name: Greenweaver
ranged.description: A keeper of gentle woodland magic who sends little sparks of frost, leaf, and lantern-light from afar.

healer.name: Hearthhealer
healer.description: A patient caretaker who restores hearts with herbal teas, warm bandages, and a listening ear.

buff_and_debuff.name: Pathfinder
buff_and_debuff.description: A clever helper who lifts companions' spirits, spots a safe way through, and distracts foes with a decoy or a tale.

races.name: Badger
races.description: Strong, steady folk who often make excellent smiths, builders, and keepers of a warm underground hearth.
races.look: A stocky upright badger with a broad, striped face, rounded ears, dark paws, and a simple work apron over a sturdy coat.

races.name: Hedgehog
races.description: Thoughtful folk whose careful hands and patient natures make them beloved healers, gardeners, and makers.
races.look: A small upright hedgehog with a soft, expressive face, neat brown spines, a knitted scarf, and a pouch of herbs at the hip.

races.name: Mouse
races.description: Quick-witted and resourceful folk, at home in snug burrows, bustling cafés, and the tiniest hidden paths.
races.look: A tiny upright mouse with round ears, bright eyes, whiskers, and a patchwork waistcoat; a teacup or crumb-sized satchel suits them.

races.name: Hare
races.description: Long-legged and keen-eyed folk, known as swift messengers, curious wanderers, and reliable friends in a pinch.
races.look: A tall, slim hare with long ears, soft russet fur, a travel cloak, and a little map tucked into a belt pouch.

races.name: Squirrel
races.description: Agile folk with sharp senses and a knack for gathering, climbing, crafting, and remembering where everything is stored.
races.look: A small upright squirrel with tufted ears, a full curled tail, warm russet fur, and a belt with seed pouches and climbing cord.

races.name: Fox
races.description: Clever, sociable folk who make good guides, storytellers, and hosts, and know the forest's quieter ways.
races.look: A graceful upright fox with russet fur, a cream-tipped muzzle and tail, alert ears, and a tidy coat with a bright scarf.

statuses.name: Burrow-Braced
statuses.description: A steady stance and a warm wall at your back make Thumps easier to weather.

statuses.name: Hearthglow
statuses.description: A little shared warmth helps turn strange Glimmers aside.

statuses.name: Quickpaw
statuses.description: Light feet find the safest paths through roots, snow, and village lanes.

statuses.name: Cloverstep
statuses.description: A lucky, nimble step makes incoming trouble easier to sidestep.

statuses.name: Keen-Eyed
statuses.description: Careful attention reveals just the right moment to land a telling blow.

statuses.name: Strongpaw
statuses.description: A good meal and a neighbor's encouragement lend extra force to Thumps.

statuses.name: Kindled
statuses.description: A bright Hearthcraft spark makes Glimmers shine a little stronger.

statuses.name: Honeyed Tea
statuses.description: Slow sips of sweet, soothing tea restore Hearts over time.

statuses.name: Frost-Nipped
statuses.description: Lingering cold stiffens paws and makes every step feel a little longer.

statuses.name: Root-Tangled
statuses.description: Stubborn roots curl around the target's feet and hold them in place.

statuses.name: Startled
statuses.description: A sudden rustle leaves the target too surprised to act for a moment.

statuses.name: Mossy Hush
statuses.description: Soft, thick moss muffles the target's voice and quiets their Hearthcraft.

statuses.name: Paws Full
statuses.description: A tumble of leaves and loose things keeps the target's paws too busy to attack.

statuses.name: Heavy-Pawed
statuses.description: Cold and weariness sap strength from the target's Thumps.

statuses.name: Dimmed Spark
statuses.description: A wavering Hearthcraft spark leaves the target's Glimmers faint.

statuses.name: Loose Guard
statuses.description: A jostled stance leaves the target less ready to turn aside Thumps.

statuses.name: Doubtful
statuses.description: A little uncertainty makes the target less able to resist Glimmers.

statuses.name: Bramble Prickles
statuses.description: Tiny thorns catch at the target, dealing a little Thump damage over time.

statuses.name: Chillglow
statuses.description: A lingering wintery shimmer deals a little Glimmer damage over time.

tier_1.name: Shield-Bump
tier_1.description: Bump one foe with your shield.

tier_1.name: Settle In
tier_1.description: Take a steady stance and brace for Thumps.

tier_2.name: Hedgehog Roll
tier_2.description: Roll into a foe, then keep your footing.

tier_2.name: Sturdy Welcome
tier_2.description: Strike nearby foes and leave them off balance.

tier_3.name: Rootwall Rush
tier_3.description: Charge a foe and hold your ground against the next blow.

tier_1.name: Pinecone Toss
tier_1.description: Toss a pinecone at one foe.

tier_1.name: Watchful Aim
tier_1.description: Take a careful moment to line up your next shot.

tier_2.name: Bramble Sling
tier_2.description: Send prickly seeds at a foe, leaving tiny thorns behind.

tier_2.name: Quick Retreat
tier_2.description: Strike a foe, then slip into a safer spot.

tier_3.name: Acorn Scatter
tier_3.description: Scatter hard acorns across a group of foes.

tier_1.name: Frostseed
tier_1.description: Send a small frost spark at one foe.

tier_1.name: Lantern Mote
tier_1.description: Call a warm light to turn aside strange Glimmers.

tier_2.name: Leafwhirl
tier_2.description: Send a swirl of bright leaves through a small group.

tier_2.name: Winter's Thread
tier_2.description: Tie a foe's paws with roots and a cold spark.

tier_3.name: Glimmerfall
tier_3.description: Let a shower of woodland lights fall on nearby foes.

tier_1.name: Herb Cup
tier_1.description: Offer an ally soothing tea that restores Hearts over time.

tier_1.name: Soft Bandage
tier_1.description: Patch up an ally and clear their troubles.

tier_2.name: Glimmering Poultice
tier_2.description: Mend an ally with a warm, glowing poultice.

tier_2.name: Careful Thump
tier_2.description: Tap a foe with your remedy satchel.

tier_3.name: Village Supper
tier_3.description: Share a hearty meal that restores Hearts and lends strength.

tier_1.name: Kind Word
tier_1.description: Encourage an ally and help them move with ease.

tier_1.name: Rustle Trick
tier_1.description: Make a sudden noise to startle one foe.

tier_2.name: False Trail
tier_2.description: Send nearby foes chasing a trail that goes nowhere.

tier_2.name: Bright Tale
tier_2.description: Tell a hopeful story that steadies an ally's Hearthcraft.

tier_3.name: Mossy Misdirection
tier_3.description: Muffle a group of foes and make their Glimmers faint.

one_handed.name: Badger's Root-Hammer
one_handed.description: A seed-sized forge hammer, balanced for brave paws and careful repairs.

two_handed.name: Hazelwood Maul
two_handed.description: A stout, two-pawed mallet that can mend a fence or send a snow-mound tumbling.

one_handed.name: Sling of Soft Acorns
one_handed.description: A nimble sling with a pouch of polished acorns, pinecones, and other safe surprises.

two_handed.name: Hawthorn Longbow
two_handed.description: A flexible bow of seasoned hawthorn, strung with braided nettle fiber.

one_handed.name: Lanternbud Wand
one_handed.description: A twig wand topped with a glowing seed; it flickers with frost, leaf, and hearthlight.

two_handed.name: Mossroot Staff
two_handed.description: A walking staff that sends gentle Glimmer dancing along its mossy roots.

one_handed.name: Hedgehog's Tea Ladle
one_handed.description: A little copper ladle for soothing sips and a surprisingly steady bonk.

two_handed.name: Herb-Sweet Censer
two_handed.description: A warm, swinging censer whose fragrant Glimmer comforts friends and startles foes.

one_handed.name: Pathfinder's Whistle
one_handed.description: A rowan whistle calls courage to friends and a distracting trill to troublemakers.

two_handed.name: Wayfarer's Walking Stick
two_handed.description: A sturdy stick for pointing out safe paths, rallying friends, or thumping a nuisance.

shields.name: Tortoiseshell Pawguard
shields.description: A polished, carefully mended shell that turns aside trouble with a reassuring clack.

shields.name: Hollow-Log Buckler
shields.description: A round shield of layered bark, light enough for small paws and stout enough for a snowball.

shields.name: Kettle-Lid Pawguard
shields.description: A well-loved brass lid from the village tea room, still faintly scented of honey.

balanced.name: Pathkeeper's Wear
balanced.description: Comfortable layers for muddy tracks, chilly waits, and lending a paw wherever needed.

sturdy.name: Forge-Friend Gear
sturdy.description: Badger-forged plates and thick padding, made for guarding neighbors in rough weather.

nimble.name: Bramble-Dancer Wear
nimble.description: Light, springy layers that slip through brambles and help quick paws leap clear.

Charm.name: First-Shoot Charm
Charm.description: A tiny green bead saved from the last spring, warm with a patient little hope.

Charm.name: Honeycomb Locket
Charm.description: A dab of honey sealed in amber; its sweetness steadies a worried heart.

Keepsake.name: Grandma's Thimble
Keepsake.description: A familiar, dented thimble that recalls every coat and friendship mended by its owner.

Keepsake.name: Café Crumb Tin
Keepsake.description: A tiny tin from the hollow-log café, carrying a crumb for courage and the way home.

healing.name: Brambleberry Mash
healing.description: A warm, tart spoonful that restores Hearts.

cleansing.name: Hedge-Healer's Broth
cleansing.description: A soothing herb broth that clears harmful statuses.

buffs.name: Badger's Seedcake
buffs.description: A firm, hearty cake that grants Burrow-Braced.

buffs.name: Hearthside Honey
buffs.description: A spoonful of honey shared by the fire grants Hearthglow.

buffs.name: Mintleaf Drops
buffs.description: A cool, fresh drop on the tongue grants Quickpaw.

buffs.name: Lucky Clover Bun
buffs.description: A soft bun with a clover tucked inside grants Cloverstep.

valuables.name: Frostglass Bead
valuables.description: A clear bead found in the snow, though the sun has not warmed it.

valuables.name: Old Shrine Bell
valuables.description: A small bronze bell from a forgotten woodland shrine.

valuables.name: Autumn Gold Leaf
valuables.description: A bright leaf that fell from a bare branch and never turned brown.

valuables.name: Mole-King's Button
valuables.description: A polished button said to have come from a very fine old coat.

valuables.name: Honeycomb Shard
valuables.description: A neat piece of honeycomb, still sweet and smelling of summer.

craft.name: Toolmaking
craft.description: Make weapons, armor, and accessories at a workshop.

brew.name: Hedge-Brewing
brew.description: Mix herbs and pantry goods into useful consumables.

upgrade.name: Gear-Mending
upgrade.description: Make your gear stronger with careful repairs.

enchant.name: Hearthcraft
enchant.description: Give gear a new property with a little woodland magic.

hard.name: Forge Bits
hard.description: Sturdy scraps for making and improving weapons and shields.

soft.name: Softgoods
soft.description: Cloth, fluff, and leather for making and improving armor and accessories.

essence.name: Glimmerdust
essence.description: Faintly shining dust used to enchant gear.

reagent.name: Hedge Herbs
reagent.description: Leaves and roots used to brew helpful consumables.

art.artStyle: Storybook watercolor and colored-pencil illustration, moss greens and honeyed browns with lingering winter blues, soft lantern glow, gentle cozy mood with quiet seasonal mystery
